run_mkdoc_extract_docs: run mkdoc.py on C++ header files to extract Doxygen comments into a C docstring header
process_comment_convert_doxygen: process_comment converts Doxygen and C++ comment syntax into Markdown-formatted docstrings
sanitize_name_clean_identifiers: sanitize_name transforms C++ identifiers including operators into valid Python docstring variable names
extract_recursively_parse_ast: extract recursively walks a Clang AST to collect documentation from classes, functions, and enums
run_extractionthread_parallel_parse: run ExtractionThread to parse multiple C++ header files in parallel using a semaphore-limited thread pool
